excerpts.author: protolambda
excerpts.content: The requirements of transactions will change towards a more stateless approach (i.e. explicit state added to transaction). At the same time, data-availability increases, so the average transaction type may also change into the direction of rollups that utilize this. And the block size and times change as well. So I don't think shard count says much.
